name: lastminute.com
description: Access real-time flight and hotel data directly through Claude to search, compare, and book flights, dynamic packages (flight + hotel), and hotels across a global network of airlines and hotel suppliers. Benefit from instant price comparisons, flexible filters, and intelligent recommendations that seamlessly integrate Claude's capabilities into your travel planning. Enhance your workflow with comprehensive flight, dynamic package, and hotel search powered by lastminute.com.

_published_faq.name: How do I add lastminute.com to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add lastminute.com to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.lastminute.com/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is lastminute.com MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, lastminute.com scores 90/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the lastminute.com MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: lastminute.com provides these MCP tools: search_flights.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to lastminute.com?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to lastminute.com in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
lastminute.com does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
lastminute.com is developed by lastminute.com. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
